Sends instant confirmation email notification via Resend / Emergent Mail service
Returns structured JSON confirmation response with custom Quote reference code (e.g. FGM-2026-8942)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow sharp-edge design (rounded-none on all buttons, inputs, cards, borders).

Build 3 core pages / views accessible via seamless SPA navigation: Home (Kinetic Hero, Manifesto, Feature Showcase, Editorial Marquee, Technical Stats), Products Catalog (All 8 components with filter by category, material specs, interactive spec drawer, and request quote trigger), and Contact / RFQ Page (Full commercial request for quotation form connected to FastAPI POST /api/quote-request).
Use Lucide-React or Phosphor Icons with crisp 1.5px stroke width.
Include high-contrast state transitions (hover, active, focus) with explicit hover text colors.
Ensure all data-testid attributes are cleanly placed on interactive elements for reliable automated testing.
